notes.title: New DLC items & Version Updates!
notes.notes:
Hello, fellows!

We are excited to announce the release of our latest DLC: Souls of Chronos - Pray of the Stars bundle. 

This DLC is designed to alleviate the burden of grinding and material farming for new players, allowing them to easily enjoy the adventurous story of Sid and Tori in Astra!

In addition, we have also launched a version update that includes the following:

- Increased difficulty in the final battle, with upgraded skills for the Divine Thunder and Osiris!
 
Divine Thunder:
- Refined Thunder's power to release it three times instead of once, with lightning strikes now tracking the player's position.
- Enhanced Thunder's protection against elemental attacks, sealing the time-stop skill while the lightning chain is active.

Osiris:
- Unleashed the full potential of the Governor in spear form, allowing him to parry all frontal attacks.
- When Governor Sterling reaches 50% health in the second phase of his spear form, he enters an invincible state and summons lightning orbs in the arena, with small batfish joining the battle. The batfish will continue to respawn as long as the orbs remain unbroken. The orbs can be destroyed by attacking them, and once all are destroyed, Governor Sterling's invincibility state ends.

We would like to express our sincere gratitude for all the support and encouragement you have given us throughout this journey. With this update, the content updates for Souls of Chronos will come to an end. We will now be fully focused on our next project, Shanghai Summer, and we hope to meet you all in the coming months!

Best regards from dev team!

notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40502505/22cd55fde1c02b455e1215a7af0671ba462a8e4e.png

Hello fellow Astra adventurers!

We are pleased to announce the latest update, version 1.5.237.1, with exciting new features and improvements.

Here are the details of the latest updates:


 Introduction of the "Time Passing" feature: In an effort to increase convenience and streamline gameplay, we have introduced the Time Passing feature. Starting with this release, you will be able to interact with Tori in town and switch between day and night without leaving your current location.

 Adjustments to selected boss abilities: To ensure a balanced and challenging combat experience, we have tweaked the skill sets of some of the late-game bosses. These tweaks will add an extra layer of excitement and strategic consideration to combat.

We truly appreciate the continued support from all players, and we remain committed to updating the game.

Thank you for your continued support!

Development Team 
June 27, 2023

notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40502505/22cd55fde1c02b455e1215a7af0671ba462a8e4e.png

Hello adventurers of Astra!

This update brings a brand new map system!

Since the release of Souls of Chronos, some players have reported difficulties in finding specific NPCs and obtaining enhancement materials with unclear locations. To address these issues, we have revamped the map system with a new UI design and added the following features:


 In the stage map, you can now view the drop materials and consumables for each stage, as well as the corresponding inventory, making weapon upgrades smoother.

 In the global map, you can see the current NPCs and their corresponding images for each area, making it easier to accept and deliver quests.

For more details, please experience it in the game!

Thank you for your continued support！

The Development Team
April 28, 2023

notes.title: Patch Notes - 1.5.227.2
notes.notes:
Dear Adventurers of Astella,

We have just released the first update since the game's launch, which addresses the following issues:

- Fixed an issue where adjusting the resolution after entering the game would lose the original resolution option.
- Fixed fullscreen display issue on certain non-16:9 screens.
- Fixed an issue where completing the Cassia side quest in Chapter 3 in advance would prevent progress in the main story.
- Fixed an issue that could occur when taking on multiple side quests at once.
- Fixed an issue where the Floating Leaf time-stop attack did not work on quick button spams.
- Removed the "Stellar!" achievement, now players can complete all achievements normally.
- Fixed an issue where game saves were not being written properly when Steam cloud saves were disabled.
- Fixed an issue where players could be stuck in the Secret Passage-15.
- Optimized overall quest configurations to reduce back-and-forth, such as allowing players to find Old Joe at the dock at the end of Chapter 1.
- Completed the "Special Thanks" list.
- Reviewed and improved certain quest names.
- Corrected some typos in the text.

Thanks for your feedback in the community - it has been tremendous help to us. We are continuing to address other reported bugs, and committed to keep updating and polishing Souls of Chronos!

The Development Team
February 16, 2023.

notes.title: "Souls of Chronos" is set to release on February 14!
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

It's been over a year since the first demo of Souls of Chronos was released on Steam, marking our RPG debut. Despite its imperfections, the demo received a tremendous amount of positive feedback and suggestions, and players fell in love with the post-apocalyptic world we created. These encouraging words fueled our passion to continually improve every aspect of the game, bringing our vision of Souls of Chronos to life.

Then, a successful crowdfunding campaign at MoDian brought in many "Founders of Astella" and led to the launch of a revamped demo in September 2022. As a group of young developers, we are overwhelmed by the increasing interest in Souls of Chronos and are deeply grateful for your continued support. Thank you!

Today, we are extremely happy to announce that Souls of Chronos is set to release on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, and PC Steam globally on February 14th! Join Sid and Torii on their thrilling adventure as they explore Astella and beyond to eventually uncover its mysterious secrets!

The Background – A Post-Apocalyptic New World

Embark on an epic journey with Sid and Tori as they explore the diverse and perilous world of Astella. From the murky underground sewers to the hidden gang hideouts, to the breathtaking terrestrial coral and the peaceful Red Woods, every location presents unique challenges and opportunities. Choose to be bold or strategic, to align with a faction or strike out on your own. Join the Chronus and the Linked as they battle for their fate in a complex web of forces that threatens to shape the future of Astella and the entire continent.

The Combat – Forge Your Own Style: Customizable Weapons & Time-bending Chrono Power

As Sid’s partner, Torii will also join the combat and fight alongside him. As they level up, players can choose different skills to master different combat styles. Also, with the progression of the story, the pair will be able to unlock new mechanisms.
As a powerful Chronus, Torii can unleash her special Chrono power to manipulate the time during combat anytime when you are at a disadvantage to turn the tide. Sid, on the other hand, can choose two weapons to equip at the same time, from a total of six distinct weapon types, each with its own upgrade path – Find the combat style that best suits you and battle some of the most fearful foes!

The Characters – Friends from Astella

The world of Astella teems with diverse NPCs, each with their own unique backgrounds and personalities. We have worked tirelessly to bring these NPCs to life, revising their character designs to reflect their stories and the factions they represent. As you navigate this post-apocalyptic world, you will have the opportunity to forge powerful alliances and join forces with them against a looming storm that threatens to upend the fragile peace.

Of course, there is much more to it! We would like to thank you once again for your continued support. We would like to invite you to share your thoughts and suggestions with us. 

We hope you all enjoy Souls of Chronos.

Sincerely,
Futu Games & Astrolabe Games

notes.title: Demo Gone, Official Release Soon!
notes.notes:
Dear players,

Since the release of the Demo in September, we have received a lot of feedback and suggestions for our community members! We are extremely grateful for your continuous support and attention, and we have made quite some corresponding revisions based on all the feedback we collected over time.

However, because of this, the Demo currently available for download is now quite outdated and thus, cannot reflect the quality of the version we are preparing to release to everyone. Therefore, we have decided to temporarily take down the Demo before the official release.

YES, YOU HEAR IT RIGHT, we are now in the final leg before the official release! As for the official release date, please allow us to keep that a secret for now and we will announce it VERY SOON.

In the upcoming official release, we will bring you the adjustments to the following area in game:

 Combat System;
 Art and Assets;
 Soundtracks and SFX;
 and everyone's favourite - Balance;


Additionally, we'd like to let you know that the official version will include a total of five chapters of the main storyline and four branching endings, based on the choices you made along the way.

We are doing our very best to ensure all of you can enjoy the fully-polished official release.

Thank you again for your attention and support, and we wish you a happy Chinese New Year! See you soon!

Your development and publishing team,
January 20th, 2023.
